title: CMS Content Lifecycle State Machine, Scheduled Publishing & Revision History

requirement.summary: CMS documents (pages, blog posts, articles) follow a deterministic state machine (draft -> scheduled -> published -> archived) with atomic transitions, stale save conflict detection, forward-only revision rollbacks, and absolute draft secrecy from unauthenticated visitors.
requirement.user_outcome: Merchants safely author drafts, schedule releases, roll back to prior revisions without data loss, and prevent concurrent overwrite conflicts.
preconditions: Document authored within merchant workspace with revision sequence tracking
Authenticated role with marketing.update or marketing.publish permissions

protected_behaviour: Draft documents are strictly inaccessible from public storefront routes
Scheduled documents remain hidden until publication timestamp is reached
Autosave updates document draft state and creates revision without altering publication status
Save operations detect stale revisions and reject concurrent conflict saves
Rollback to a past revision appends a new forward revision, preserving complete audit history
forbidden_behaviour: Draft content leaking to public or search indexing crawlers
Silent overwrite of newer revisions during concurrent authoring sessions
Unauthorized actors directly transitioning draft documents to published state
Destructive rollback truncating or deleting revision records

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Allow draft documents to be returned by public page resolver
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected draft document to be inaccessible publicly

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Remove updatedAt conflict check in saveEditor
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected stale save to throw stale_revision
